sections.summary: REPLACE: Plain-language summary (Art. 19 Abs. 6 MiCAR): the warnings of field I.04, the token's characteristics, the statement that holders have a right of redemption at any time with the conditions for redemption, and the key information about the offer to the public or the intended admission to trading (Anhang Tabelle 3 Felder I.04 bis I.07 VO (EU) 2024/2984). The linter expects at least 80 words.
sections.risk_warning: REPLACE: The statement of Art. 19 Abs. 4 MiCAR in the predefined wording of field I.02 (Anhang Tabelle 3 VO (EU) 2024/2984): loss of value in part or in full, transferability, liquidity, investor compensation schemes, deposit guarantee schemes.
sections.management_statement: REPLACE: The statement of the management body under Art. 19 Abs. 5 MiCAR in the predefined wording of field I.03 (Anhang Tabelle 3 VO (EU) 2024/2984): compliance with Title III and, to the best of the management body's knowledge, information that is fair, clear and not misleading and no omission likely to affect its import. The linter checks key terms only.
sections.notification_date: REPLACE: Date of notification of the white paper (Art. 19 Abs. 7 MiCAR).
sections.language: REPLACE: State the language of the white paper and why it satisfies Art. 19 Abs. 8 MiCAR (official language of the home Member State or a language customary in international finance).
sections.issuer: REPLACE: Name, registration date, LEI or national identifier; identity, business addresses and functions of management body members; business activity, also of any parent company; financial condition; governance arrangements; authorisation and granting authority (credit institutions: home Member State authority); other crypto-assets, related activities and any link to the DLT operator (Anhang II Teil A MiCAR). Without an LEI, also legal form, registered address, head office and parent identity (VO (EU) 2024/2984).
sections.art: REPLACE: Name and ticker of the asset-referenced token, its characteristics, the persons involved in its operationalisation, the role, responsibilities and accountability of any third-party entities under Art. 34 Abs. 5 UAbs. 1 Buchst. h MiCAR, and the plans for the token with its past and future milestones (Anhang II Teil B MiCAR).
sections.offer_or_admission: REPLACE: Whether the white paper concerns an offer to the public or an admission to trading, the prospective holders targeted, subscription mechanics, and the law applicable to the offer with the competent court (Anhang II Teil C MiCAR).
sections.rights_and_obligations: REPLACE: Rights and obligations: the permanent right of redemption (Art. 39 MiCAR); the claim with each asset the token references and its proportion, how their value relates to the claim and the reserve, and how its components are fairly and transparently valued (Anhang II Teil D Nr. 10 MiCAR); complaints procedures; transfer restrictions.
sections.technology: REPLACE: The distributed ledger technology, protocols and technical standards, the consensus mechanism, incentive mechanisms and fees, and the audit outcome of the technology used (Anhang II Teil E MiCAR).
sections.risks: REPLACE: The risks of the reserve of assets, the issuer, the offer to the public or the admission to trading, the token and its referenced assets, the operationalisation of the project, and the technology used, with any mitigation measures (Anhang II Teil F MiCAR).
sections.reserve_of_assets: REPLACE: The mechanism aligning the value of the reserve with the claim, the reserve of assets and its composition, the issuance and redemption mechanisms, any investment policy, and the custody arrangements with their segregation (Anhang II Teil G MiCAR).
sections.environmental_impact: REPLACE: Principal adverse impacts on the climate of the consensus mechanism, per the ESMA sustainability-indicator RTS.
sections.redemption: REPLACE: How the issuer redeems (in funds other than electronic money at the market value of the referenced assets, or by delivering those assets), the procedure and its timeframe, that redemption carries no fee outside the recovery plan (Art. 39 Abs. 3 MiCAR), and the conditions for any suspension of redemption under Art. 46 MiCAR.
